lines.text: After cutting off the power in the generator room, Elegg joins the others in repairing the Tetrapod.
While Privaty watches over from a higher vantage point,
the rest of us stare at Neon, who is crouched in front of the lake.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: All right... I'm going to put it in.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Just stick your hand in the water already! We haven't got all day.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: But the water might still be electrified.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The electricity's been cut off.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: You never know.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Good grief, move over. I'll do it.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Okay, okay! I'm going.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: *Gulp*...
*Splash*

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Uhgyahhhhh!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Ahhhhh!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Hehe, I knew that would scare you.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Pretty funny, huh?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah. Hilarious.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Now all that's left is to drain the water from the lake.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How do we do that though?

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I doubt that the draining system is working as intended.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: It's probably being blocked by something.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Some kind of obstruction...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Is it what I think it is?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Probably.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I'll dive in and check.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: You can swim?

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Of course I can.
Oh, that's right. So can I.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Can Nikkes not swim?
Nope. They weigh too much.
Okay, bad joke, but it is true that they can't swim.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I see. Well, I think it's best that you stay here.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: It's best for commanders to stay out of harm's way.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: That's often a problem for us, since Master likes to overexert himself.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I'll check the drainage area and see if there are any obstructions that need to be removed.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: How long can you hold your breath?

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Not sure. I've always finished what I needed to do before it became an issue.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What? You've never run out of breath underwater?

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Nope, never.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How does that make any sense...?

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I'll show you. I'll be back.
Wait, you should set up a signal to let us know if you're in trouble!
*Splash*
EVE dives into the water with perfect form.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Maybe we could toss in some fishing line? That way she could grab on and pull herself out if she needs to.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I don't think that would do much.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Let's just wait here for now. If we feel something is wrong, then we'll go in immediately and...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: We won't be able to save someone who's submerged in water.
If anything happens, I'll go in.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... Okay. If anything happens, you'll have to take over.
10 minutes later.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... Don't you think she's taking too long?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Trained divers can stay underwater for over 10 minutes, but...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I can't wait any more. Let's throw in a fishing line.
I'll go in. First, let's attach some fishing line to me.
We hurriedly wrap a fishing line around my waist.
I'll be back. While I'm gone, be sure t...
*Splash*
EVE emerges from the lake, sending water spraying every which way.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Whew...
She lifts herself out of the water, and stares at us.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: ... Are you trying to fish by using the Commander as bait?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Er... not quite.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: The drainage system is working fine. Nothing is blocking the main system.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Then the problem must be with one of the drain pipes connected to it.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Yeah. There's probably a blocked drain pipe somewhere on the outskirts of the city.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Okay, let's go investigate.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What was inside the lake?

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: The ground floor seems to have been some sort of plaza.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I saw some benches and streetlights.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You know that's not what I'm asking.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: ... On the floor, there were three bodies lying on top of a door.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: One of them was missing an arm.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: On top of a door, you said?

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Yes. Maybe they died while they were trying to get inside somewhere.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: There were traces of welding marks on the outside of the door.
I think we need to try talking to Com again.
We found three dead Nikkes on top of what appears to be a large door on the ground floor.
Do you know anything about that?

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: No, I don't.
What's behind that door?

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Com is unintelligent, and doesn't know much.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Shut up. I'm not dumb.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: If you were smart, then you would be able to answer.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I won't fall for such simplistic provocations.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Whoa, this is some high-level psychological warfare we're witnessing.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Never thought I'd live to see the day where two robots are bickering.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Can't we just pry it open and parse through its data?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yes, but we don't have the necessary tools.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: They do in the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Well, we're not in the Ark, are we?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: We could take it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Take it where?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I was going to mention this earlier.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Finding an old robot like this is a rare occurrence. It could contain valuable historical data.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I've been waiting for the ideal time to take it back to the Ark and examine it,

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: and now would seem to be the perfect time.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: If we're taking this one, it would be good if Roam came too, since it has spent a lot of time on the surface as well.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: What will happen to it after you bring it to the Ark?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: The data it contains will be analyzed in detail.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: And after?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: After that... the Central Government will handle it.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: So it wouldn't be sent back to the surface.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Most likely, no.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: I need to collect artifacts and build a second Ark.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: I need to stay on the surface.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: You'll take me to the Ark?

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I'd rather self-destruct than go there!

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Com does not have the ability to self-detonate. It is a bluff.
I won't send Roam and Com to the Ark.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: ... Commander.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Then you clearly don't care about the safety of the Ark.
What?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Although we don't know precisely what kind of data these two robots contain, it is highly probable that whatever it is will be of immense value to the Ark.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: At the very least, we could ascertain how frequently they encountered Raptures in the areas they've been previously, or what types of Raptures.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Robots that have operated solo on the surface for an extended period are exceedingly uncommon.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: They will absolutely be useful to the Ark. That much is certain.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I appreciate that you have respect for other people and objects. That's why I like you.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: However, I don't want you to run afoul of the top brass because of it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I can't believe you just said that!

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You just said you like him!

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I did? N-no, I meant...!

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I meant I respect him as a soldier! Not anything romantic!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: That better be what you meant.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Of course it was! What are you insinuating?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: A-anyway. I know you have a proclivity for stubbornness, Commander,

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: but please, for once, I'm asking you to compromise on this.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: The data these two robots contain is more valuable than you can possibly imagine.
No.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Fine. How about this, then?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: We'll designate Roam and Com as honorary members of the Counters Squad.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: That way, no one will be able to mistreat them.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Oh, that's a good idea.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: That will also justify us sending them right back to the surface after we've analyzed their data.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I'll personally ensure that it's done.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: I will be the Commander's colleague? How exciting!
You were my colleague from the start.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: How exciting! So exciting!
Are you okay with going to the Ark, Roam?

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: I'm okay. I'm curious about the Ark.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I won't go. The moment I set foot in a filthy cesspool like that, my brain is likely to rot.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: You do not have a physical brain, and it will not rot.
Sorry Com, but you don't have much of a choice here.
Either cooperate with us and accept the deal, or we'll leave you entirely at the mercy of the Ark.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I suppose that settles it then.
Privaty turns her head toward the Tetrapod.
Lily, Adam, and Elegg are hard at work with the repairs.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: ... Hmph. You see? I told you I could get things done.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Who are you talking to?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: No one. It's nothing.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I'll get moving, along with Roam and Com, once you're done checking out the drain pipes.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I'll mark the location on the map for you.
